recipes.name: Creamy Beetroot & Sweet Potato Soup
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over high heat. Add the onion and salt, and cook for 5 to 7 minutes, or until golden. Add splashes of water as needed to deglaze the pan.
Add the garlic and stir until golden, about 2 minutes.
Then sprinkle in the spices and toast for 30 seconds, stirring throughout.
Add the sweet potatoes, beets, and broth. Bring to a boil, reduce to a simmer, partially cover, and cook for 25 to 30 minutes.
Once the potatoes and beetroots are soft, add the coconut milk and purée using an immersion blender or standing blender.
Taste and add more salt if you'd like. Serve with desired garnishes. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 4 days. Store in the freezer for up to 2 months.
